summary: Math needs 24 units, science 13 and engineering fundamentals 8: the listed required courses, plus any of the additional courses to reach each total. CHEM 31A and 31B together can replace CHEM 31E. Every course needs a C or better. The Aircraft capstone needs AA 102 and the Spacecraft capstone needs AA 179. Only 3 units of AA 190 or AA 199 count unless you are in honors. You check by hand your Technology in Society course from the School of Engineering list, the 2.5 combined GPA, and for honors the approved thesis.
